今天不要上班，咪养你: No Work Today. Mii’s Got You.
九个超现实场景里，安静的物件在触碰下开花: In nine surreal scenes, quiet everyday objects bloom at your touch.

触碰深海生物身上的 12 个彩色声点作曲，AI 把这段演奏发展成一首完整的歌: Compose with 12 colorful sound points on a deep-sea creature, then let AI develop your performance into a complete song.
悬浮在云海蓝调时刻的 Y3K 梦核艺术空间，五个场域可 360° 环视与拍摄: A Y3K dreamscape floating above a blue-hour sea of clouds. Explore and photograph five spaces in 360°.
沿着亮起的格子把豆子按上钉板，铺烫纸、拖熨斗，熔成一整块像素画: Place beads on the glowing grid, lay down ironing paper and glide the iron across to fuse your own pixel artwork.
十六台机身，一次一格: Sixteen camera bodies. One frame at a time.
雾蓝背景里悬浮的银色罐体与虹彩反光，让动作本身产生美感: A silver vessel floats against misty blue, its iridescent reflections turning movement into a visual ritual.
走进一个互联网大小的衣柜，每件单品真的穿在你身上: Step into an internet-sized wardrobe and try every piece on yourself.
对着摄像头张开手，指尖之间拉出一扇实时滤镜与 AI 分身的窗口，点一下录像: Open your hand in front of the camera to stretch a window of live filters and AI doubles between your fingertips. Tap to record.
手指就是一支有边界的沙粒画笔，六组沙色与三档笔刷随时切换: Your finger becomes a sand brush. Switch between six palettes and three brush sizes as you draw.
一条金鱼从半升借来的水开始，二十种生物随栖息地升级依次入住: A goldfish begins with half a liter of borrowed water. Twenty creatures move in as you upgrade its habitat.
一台可环视、投币操作的立体美食娃娃机；20 秒内夹到什么，今天就吃什么: Explore a 3D food claw machine, insert a coin and grab a snack in 20 seconds. Whatever you catch is today's meal.
在开源 2048 基础上的二次创作版本: A creative remix of the open-source 2048 game.
把照片交给误判局，撑过三道面无表情的提问，领一张机器认错人的认证: Give the Bureau of Misjudgment a photo, answer three deadpan questions and receive an official certificate of mistaken identity.
涂几笔发光线条，听它们变成音符、长成一首 30 秒的歌，再压成自己的首张单曲: Draw glowing lines, hear them become notes and grow into a 30-second song, then press your debut single.
45–60 秒的平行人生体验，发给你一份来自另一条人生的 offer: A 45–60 second glimpse of a parallel life, complete with an offer from the path you never took.
上传自拍，兽性扫描仪告诉你你其实是哪只动物，附一句面无表情的 AI 判词: Upload a selfie and let the beast scanner reveal your inner animal, with a deadpan AI verdict.
喂它一张照片，动物零件硬切贴满每张脸，拖动调整、重新洗牌: Feed it a photo and watch animal features collide with every face. Drag to adjust or shuffle for another mix.
客户房间的杂物全部飞起悬浮，一件件拖回该去的地方，清单全绿后盖章交付: A client's clutter floats in the air. Drag each object back where it belongs, then stamp the finished checklist.
用芭比娃娃挡住脸拍照，娃娃的五官与接缝跟着你的脸对齐: Pose with a doll face aligned to your own features and contours.
拍一张食物照片，得到可编辑的热量与三大营养素，确认后加进当天仪表盘: Photograph a meal to get editable calorie and macronutrient estimates, then add the confirmed entry to your daily dashboard.
心里想一个问题，在双手间聚起一颗活的星，放进摊开的书里: Hold a question in your mind, gather a living star between your hands and place it in an open book.
一间安静的印刷工作室，把你的照片重排成由几个巨大变形文字组成的海报: A quiet print studio transforms your photo into a poster made from bold, distorted typography.
画三条线建成城市，探索主题任务、居民委托、买车与住宅；当前版源码与 waku 壳: Draw three lines to build a city. Explore themed missions, help residents and discover cars and homes.
把熟悉的世界重新打上马赛克；题库涵盖动物纹理、食物切面、世界地标: Rediscover familiar things behind a mosaic: animal textures, sliced foods and landmarks from around the world.
打开相机，看看今天哪个动漫角色误入了你的世界，再和它合张影: Open the camera to discover which anime character has wandered into your world today, then take a photo together.
一座长在指尖上的花园，摄像头认手，单手起势、双手合奏: A garden grows at your fingertips. Camera-based hand tracking lets one hand begin and two hands perform together.
竖屏触控的电子插花，在光信号里搭出一束花: Arrange a bouquet of light in a portrait-format digital flower studio.
把单手 8 拍或双手 3 段编排，悄悄变成一支个人手势舞视频: Turn an eight-beat one-hand routine or a three-part two-hand sequence into your own gesture dance video.
画一个字母，看它长成你自己的一套字体: Draw a letter and watch it grow into your very own typeface.
把自己涂成场景的颜色藏起来，和寻找者玩一局伪装躲猫猫: Paint yourself in the colors of the scene and hide from the seeker in a game of camouflage.
把照片送进方块传送门：人和动物保留原样，周围环境整个重建成 3D 方块世界: Send a photo through a block-world portal: people and animals stay intact while the surroundings become a 3D voxel world.
拍一组四格照，再发现每张照片都偷偷留下了快门前后那一秒: Take four photo-booth shots, then discover the second of motion quietly captured around each shutter click.
在淡线球体里拖动旋转和倾斜得到一个新机位，为竖屏内容生成多角度画面: Rotate and tilt a wireframe sphere to find a new camera position and generate multiple angles for portrait content.
手绘或上传草图生成完整角色，六项对话确认身份，收进自己的档案库: Draw or upload a sketch to create a complete character. Define their identity through six prompts and add them to your archive.
对准自己，瞬间变成任何东西——鸡块、云、行星，五官仍是你的: Point the camera at yourself and become anything—a nugget, a cloud or a planet—with your own facial features.
上传今天的穿搭，一个同款卡通小人贴进你的照片里: Upload today's outfit and a matching cartoon mini-me joins you in the photo.
上传宠物，见到它私底下的人类身份，一张满版明星写真: Upload your pet and discover their secret human identity in a full-frame celebrity portrait.
面向猫、狗和鸟的生物声学翻译装置，你出声，它回话: A playful bioacoustic translator for cats, dogs and birds. You make a sound; it answers.
口袋宠物实验室，捏一只属于自己的 3D 小猫: A pocket pet laboratory where you sculpt your own 3D kitten.
每个方块都是一只小动物，把整个房间塞满、不留缝隙: Every block is a small animal. Fill the room without leaving a gap.
可连续换主题的中文节奏听说接龙: A Chinese rhythm-and-speech relay with themes you can keep switching.
从开源迷宫游戏二创而来的插画式迷宫: An illustrated maze reimagined from an open-source maze game.
用自己的照片做的闪光数字填色游戏: Turn your own photo into a sparkling paint-by-numbers game.
口袋配音棚：选一个角色给一场戏配音、换情绪重来，AI 评委给你一张试镜卡: A pocket dubbing studio: voice a scene, try another emotion and receive an audition card from an AI judge.
拍下任何人——朋友、妈妈、狗——AI 裁判亢奋地宣布他的动画分身: Photograph a friend, your mom or even your dog, and an enthusiastic AI judge reveals their animated double.
一台口袋大头贴机，开机就已经戴着本周互联网热度第一的审美: A pocket photo booth that opens wearing the internet's hottest aesthetic of the week.
奢侈品、汽车、地标、名画题库，五轮四选一找出唯一的真版本: Spot the one authentic version in five rounds of four choices, from luxury goods and cars to landmarks and famous paintings.
持续更刊的双面新闻报：A 面热点配互动图解，B 面入口通往 waku 作品: An evolving, two-sided newspaper: topical stories with interactive diagrams on side A, and portals to waku creations on side B.
十二个精选合集的活壁纸画廊，滑动收藏，再揭开一张独一无二的: A living wallpaper gallery with twelve curated collections. Swipe to save favorites, then uncover one that's uniquely yours.
竖屏 3D 互动叙事：把 350 点人生资源分配出去，换一个愿望，签一张契约: A portrait-format 3D interactive story: distribute 350 life-resource points, trade for a wish and sign the contract.
框住照片的任何一块——一只眼、半张脸——它就变成黑白漫画分镜: Frame any part of a photo—an eye, half a face—and turn it into a black-and-white manga panel.
让小猫接管今天，选择回应、摸摸它，在陪伴中慢下来。: Let a little cat take charge of your day. Choose your responses, give it a gentle pat and slow down in good company.
在海边小镇与他再次相遇，用你的回应、靠近和记录，让心动一天一天延续。: Meet him again in a seaside town. Your replies, small steps closer and shared memories keep the spark alive, day after day.
在午夜邂逅 Magnus。靠近危险，也在一次次选择中改写彼此的关系。: Meet Magnus at midnight. Step closer to danger and reshape your relationship with every choice.
以女主第一视角进入海洋奇幻故事，让你的回应推动情节。: Enter an ocean fantasy through the heroine’s eyes, where your responses move the story forward.
一只没人要的黑猫，在天亮后变成了你厨房里的陌生男人。: An unwanted black cat becomes a stranger in your kitchen when morning comes.
把视觉、互动、声音、个人结果与交付验证放进同一条创作流程。: Bring visuals, interaction, sound, personal outcomes and delivery checks into one creative process.
先定义体验，再搭界面: Define the experience before the interface
先明确进入情境、用户动作、即时反馈与最终结果。围绕一个核心乐趣，形成 Hook: Define the entry situation, user action, immediate feedback and final outcome. Build around one core pleasure: hook → action → feedback → state change → a personal result.
让画面、声音和交互属于同一个世界: Make visuals, sound and interaction belong to one world
从真实资产出发建立材质、光线和运动节奏。生成、预览、保存和分享使用同一份结果，避: Use real assets to establish materials, lighting and motion. Generation, preview, saving and sharing should all use the same result, so visitors can take away what they see.
从第一版考虑交付: Design for delivery from the first version
移动视口、安全区、生命周期、双语、素材和 QA 判据同时进入第一版。局部改进沿着: Consider mobile viewports, safe areas, lifecycle behavior, bilingual content, assets and QA criteria from the first version. Improve the work while preserving what has already been approved.

例如“今天不牵手，但你可以留下”同时包含拒绝触碰与允许陪伴。不能只匹配到“牵手”: “No holding hands today, but you can stay” both declines touch and welcomes company. Matching the words “holding hands” alone must not trigger that action.

描述谁接收到什么，如何回应，手、眼神、道具与距离怎样变化。摄影区分位置路径、观察: Describe who perceives what and how they respond, including hands, eyelines, props and distance. Specify camera path, viewing direction, focus, motivation and stopping position.

写下动作开始时的真实状态和计划出口。下一镜接续的是审核过的成片出口，而不是尚未发: Record the actual starting state and planned exit. The next shot continues from the reviewed output, not from an outcome that has yet to happen.
区分结构正确、视听成立、完整可玩与真实设备验证，让每个结论有对应证据。: Distinguish structural correctness, audiovisual quality, complete playability and real-device validation, with evidence for every conclusion.
构建检查证明程序可以产出；结构测试证明状态和协议；动态审片验证表演与接镜；完整体: Build checks show that the program can produce output; structural tests check states and protocols; motion review checks performance and shot transitions; a full walkthrough tests whether the interaction works.
结论附带范围与证据: Attach scope and evidence to every conclusion
使用通过、未通过、未验证、不适用四种状态。记录版本、对象、检查方式和证据，不把桌: Use four statuses: passed, failed, unverified and not applicable. Record the version, subject, method and evidence. Desktop simulation is not the same as real-device testing.
围绕失败的转移、前后接点及相关分支回归。把问题落实到具体对象，而不是只有一句“整: Retest the failed transition, its neighboring connections and related branches. Tie each issue to a specific object rather than a vague request to “improve everything.”

My work spans creative concepts, visual direction, image and video generation, interactive prototypes, model evaluation and creative workflows. I turn that practice into reusable skills, prompts and workflows that help ideas take shape.
